top_signals.title: Stock-Market Gains Are Weakest After Midterm Results Like These
top_signals.summary: While US midterm election results historically bode well for stocks regardless of which party wins, some Wall Street strategists are warning clients to temper their bullishness this time around.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Democrats deliver crushing defeat as voters punish administration for high cost of living

top_signals.summary: A major Russian web hosting provider is struggling to restore its services after a cyberattack destroyed data across its cloud infrastructure and disrupted hundreds of websites.
